meta.title: Implement per-frame command allocators
meta.body_summary: Implement per-frame D3D12 command allocators to avoid potential contention and improve GPU command recording latency.

perf_labels.notes: Small self-merged PR adding per-frame D3D12 command allocators; no review or performance evidence, narrative claim only.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 44 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a tiny, low-risk performance PR that was self-merged instantly without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comment text in dataset; PR merged by author without external validation.
review_details.performance_claim: Using per-frame command allocators reduces GPU command recording latency by avoiding contention on a single allocator.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: D3D12 allocator management is a specific graphics API pattern; Codex produced a correct small change with no review friction.

core_change_summary.description: In d3d12hook.cpp, replaced the single D3D12 command allocator with an array of per-frame allocators, updated command list recording to use the current frame's allocator, and added allocation/release logic for the new allocators.
change_trajectory: Single commit: refactored command allocator management to be per-frame.
